name: XAUUSD_ATR_EXPANSION_TREND

entry_rules.hypothesis: ATR-expansion trend scalper. Trade with the H1 trend direction only when M5 volatility is expanding (ATR14 > 50-bar ATR mean). Entry on pullback to EMA21 with continuation candle confirmation. Stops are ATR-based, targets at fixed R:R. Filters: London/NY session, spread < 3 pips, trend-aligned (price above fast EMA for buy).

entry_trigger.condition: M5 H1-trend-aligned + ATR expanding + pullback to EMA(pull) within pullback_threshold*ATR + continuation candle (close > open for buy)
entry_trigger.buy: H1 up + price > EMA(fast) + ATR expanding + pullback to EMA(pull) + close > open
entry_trigger.sell: H1 down + price < EMA(fast) + ATR expanding + pullback to EMA(pull) + close < open

stop.description: ATR-based stop below pullback low (buy) or above (sell)

description: V9: ATR Expansion Trend Scalper. Trades M5 continuation pullbacks in the direction of H1 trend, only when volatility is expanding. A different hypothesis from V1-V8: combines H1 higher-timeframe trend with M5 pullback timing + ATR expansion filter, rather than structure-break or pure candle patterns.

research_results.hypothesis: M5 pullback entries in the direction of H1 EMA trend, filtered by ATR expansion, produce positive expectancy after trading costs.

grid_search_train.result: NO config with positive TRAIN net and >=15 trades

research_results.conclusion: NO EDGE. Best TRAIN config has PF=0.06 and 14% win rate. Validation has 0% win rate (27 trades, 0 winners). Walk-forward shows consistent losses across all 6 windows (OOS mean -58.7 pips). Full dataset: PF=0.03, 8% win rate, sharpe=-1.58. The ATR-expansion pullback filter produces extremely few signals with catastrophic win rates. Adding H1 trend confluence + ATR expansion does not improve over V1-V8 — the fundamental issue remains: M5/M15 gold price action has no exploitable edge after costs. REJECTED.

notes: Research script: research/v9_atr_expansion_trend.py — no MT5 writes, no live trading, no fabrication. All numbers computed from db/trading.db (XAUUSD M15: 47398 bars, M5: 35797 bars). H1 resampled from M15.
